name: house-clock
description: One line under every message: the day, the date, the time, and how long since your previous message. So the model knows when it is.

show.title: What the line shows
show.description: Comma list among: gap (how long since your previous message), battery, disk. Or: none. Example: gap,battery,disk

format.title: Date and time format
format.description: A strftime format. Example for time only: %H:%M

label.title: Label
label.description: The words between the brackets at the start of the line.
